team.title: The team behind *EV Investment*
team.intro: A partnership of investment, risk and technology specialists building institutional-grade access to Vietnam's premium coastal real estate — on the ground in Quy Nhon and Da Nang.
team.leadership.title: Led by *Institutional Pioneers*
team.leadership.intro: Our partners pair hands-on investment, risk-modelling and development experience with on-the-ground execution in Quy Nhon and Da Nang — local presence held to institutional discipline.
team.leadership.photoAlt: EV Investment boardroom in Quy Nhon
team.philosophy.title: A discipline, not a pitch
team.philosophy.macro.title: Macro-first research
team.philosophy.macro.body: Every position starts from a top-down read of Vietnam's growth, urbanisation and coastal-tourism cycles — not from a single deal.
team.philosophy.risk.title: Technology-driven risk
team.philosophy.risk.body: We build our own risk and research stack — algorithmic modelling and conservative leverage are set before capital is committed, so downside is sized before upside is sold.
team.philosophy.roots.title: Local roots, institutional standards
team.philosophy.roots.body: On-the-ground presence in Quy Nhon and Da Nang paired with the reporting, governance and transparency international partners expect.

hiring.hero.intro: EV Investment develops premium coastal assets in Quy Nhơn — and we're hiring senior people across investment, development, and client advisory. Find your role below.

hiring.why.focus.body: A focused thesis: 100% concentration and expertise in today's most promising emerging market.
hiring.why.rigor.title: Institutional rigor
hiring.why.rigor.body: Data-driven research and underwriting on assets you can stand in front of.
hiring.why.scale.title: Ground-floor scale
hiring.why.scale.body: Join early. Your work compounds into the fund's track record — and your own.
hiring.why.upside.title: Aligned upside

home.hero.copy.line2: See why and how to invest directly. China+1 narrative ensures consistently increasing FDI inflows.
home.hero.copy.edge: our visarun branch lets us keep a pulse on regional trends in foreign purchases.
home.hero.b.headline:
Invest in *Quy Nhon*
Through Institutional Vision.
home.hero.b.copy: EV Investment bridges the gap between premium coastal real estate development and sophisticated investors. Experience high-yield real estate assets in Vietnam's fastest-growing coastal hub.
home.fieldNotes.title: Field Notes from *Quy Nhơn*
home.fieldNotes.intro: Research explains the thesis. Field notes show you the place — our people on the ground, filming the districts we underwrite, the roads being built, and what daily life actually costs.
home.research.title: Data-Driven *Research & Insights*
home.research.intro: We believe in deep macroeconomic analysis. Our research team produces exhaustive monthly reports on Vietnam’s economic landscape, urbanization trends, and Quy Nhon’s real estate cycles.
home.research.leadAuthor: Lead Author: Dr. Nguyen An, Chief Economist
publications.title: Field Notes *& Research*
publications.intro: Three kinds of evidence. Research is the desk work — macro models, land sweeps, yield decomposition, published as citable PDFs. Field notes are the ground truth: our people filming the districts we underwrite. The whitepaper is the standing document behind both.
